connector.name: MCP by promptarch.ai
connector.registryDescription: Research-backed linting + generation for agent context files (CLAUDE.md, AGENTS.md, Cursor rules).
connector.summary: Hosted at mcp.promptarch.ai over streamable HTTP. Needs a bearer token header, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published under the verified namespace ai.promptarch, which resolves to the same domain as the linked website. That pairing is the strongest ownership signal the registry exposes.
connector.authNote: A bearer token is sent in a request header. Store it outside the config file wherever your client supports it.

headers.name: Authorization
headers.description: Optional. Bearer pk_… PromptArch API key — required only for promptarch_generate_artifact; lint and list work without it.
